translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Dios Noéba veta' veta'tsanguedaa timi.
Dios, Noénu bain, naa ya' nalanu bain mika ura' de-isa ti' entsandimi: Pure' na miyandiyai', tunu yallui seradei.
Naaju animaala bain ñullanu yuj jeemunu detsuve. Tsenmin kumuinchi animaalanu, naa kai'sha, naa tusha, naa pisha pumulanu bain, ñullaa uudenguentsunu detsuve.
Tsenmin ti animaalanu bain ñulla finuu dejuve, matyu iya ñullanu ti buikiyalanu bain naake kuwa'ba entsa animaalanu bain finu juntsangue kuwantsuyu.
Tsaaren ñulla allanu asa erei'mujchiya finu dejutyuve, asaa chuwaamuñu' mitya.
Naa chachilla bain, naa animaala bain chachinu tute' asa shajaakaren mitya, yalanu kuipa faawaanu tsuyu. Tsenmin mun chachi tute'ba main main juntsa chachi' mitya kavitu inu detsuve.
Mun vee chachinu tute' bain, ya bain vee rukuchi tutanu tsuve, matyu chachiya Dios naajuñuba ya keraaya imuwaañu' mitya.
Tsaaren ñullaya na pure' miyandiyai', nuka bain tyuwai seradei, timi.
Tsejtu Dios, Noénu bain, naa ya' nalanu bain entsandimi:
Challa ñullanu bain, naa ñullanu sera' jimulanu bain veta' veta' tsanguedaa tintsuyu.

Tsenmin kumuinchi animaa baakusha pu' mala' ñuiba chudenashu juntsalanu bain, naa pishkulanu bain, naa cha' miyanuu animaalanu bain, naa ajara animaalanu bain, matyu kumuinchi tunu chumu animaalanuya tsaren tsanguenbera kenu tsuyu tintsuyu.

Tsa' mitya iya ñullanu naakenu pa' bain jaiba vera' manban jutyuyu: Umaa naa-uwanuba shuwa pure' jakaake', pi bu'ware' chachillanu bain, naa animaalanu bain demanbiren jutyuyu. Tsenmin shuwa tsamantsai maja' entsa tu manbirekenuuya naa-uwanuba majun jutyuve, timi.
Tsejtu Dios tsandimi: Iya ñullanu bain, naa naaju animaalanu bain pi bu'ware' manbiren jutyuyu tyeeshu juntsa ñuiba veta' veta' tsanguedaa ti' keewaanu tsuyu.
Iya ñivijchatala arku iris tingaayu, matyu juntsaa iya entsa tuba veta' veta' tsanguedaa tiñu keewara junu tsuve.
Tsa' mitya iya naa-uwanu tusha ñivijcha pajteñu ñivijchatala in arku iris fale' tindiñuba
iya ñullanu bain, naa animaalanu bain veta' veta' naakenu pamuwa ju'ba juntsa mandenganu tsuyu. Tsejtu umaa shuwa pure' jakaake' demanbirenu jutyuyu.

Tsaju' naa-uwanu arku iris ñivijchatala tinna kata' bain, naa-uwanu' mityaba veta' veta' naa naakenu pa', naa in chachillanu bain, naa kumuinchi entsa tunu chumu animaalanu bain manbiren jutyu ju'ba mandenganu tsuyu.
Tsaju' entsa palaaya iya entsa tunu chumulanu veta' veta' naa naakenu pañuba juntsa keewara juve, timi. Tsejtu Dios juntsaaya pami Noénu.
Noé ya' nalaba
Noé' nala baakusha pu' malumula Sem bain, Cam bain, Jafet bain juula. Camya, Canaán' ya' apa tiyamuwaami.
Entsa pemalaa Noé' nala jumuwaala. Tsenñu entsalanu sera' jimulaa kumuinchi entsa tunu chachi demasera' chula.
Tsenmala Noéya tunu buikiya wajken chumuwaatu, yaa ajke' uva vijtya ke' awakaamuwaami.
Tsejtu umaa ma malu Noé binu kushtu tsaa viñaimi, tsai' ya' yapayanu chipa kejtala cha'tene juu tya'pu' kasu'tsunami.
Tsenñu Canaánchi ya' apa jumu, Cam, ya' apanu cha'tene juu tsuna katamin, avindala malu', ya' vejan pai naatalalanu kuinda kijiimi.
Tsenñu Sem, Jafetba jali ka', yala' palanu llatikare' ji' ya' apanu juntsachi vikaala. Tsejtu yalaa ya' apanu cha'tene juu katan detyatyu' mitya, benga' mitya vee mujtu ke-eraa tene jiila.
Tsenñu Noé viña' tsu' mandengatu mijami ya' kayi na yanu tyee kiñuba.
Tsejtu tsandimi: ¡Dioschi firu' isa Canaán! ¡Matyu ya' naatalala' tiba kiikemu chachiitala yaa kayu balejtu kuraa chachi junu tsuve! timi.
Tsejtu bene kayu patu tsandimi: Yavé, Sem' Diosya, mika urave tikayasa, tsenmala Canaánya Semchi tiba kiikemu chachi jusa.
Tsenmin Dios, Jafetnu bain aawa tiwaasa; tsenmin Sem' chunu tunuren ya bain chusa, tsenmala Canaánya yachi tiba kiikemu chachi jusa, timi.
Pi bu'dunda' dyañu, bene Noé kayu 350 añu manchumi.
Tsejtu kumuinchibi 950 añu juunu uwanu peyami.

footnotes.text: 9.20 yaa ajke' uva vijtya ke' awakaamuwaami: Naa tsandityu'ba, mantsalaya entsandi aseetanguikarave tyamu deeve: Noéya tunu buikiya tene wajken chutu uva vijtya ke' awakaami.
